body.name: \(\operatorname{OT}\)
body.sig: \(\mathcal P(\mathbb T^2)\times\mathcal P(\mathbb T^2)\to(\mathbb T^2\to\mathbb T^2)\)
body.def: The unique almost-everywhere optimal map for the intrinsic cost \(c_{\mathbb T}\) between absolutely continuous torus laws; on the smooth class it is an identity-homotopic torus diffeomorphism.
